researchHighlights.dissertationTitle: Evaluating the Security of AI-Generated Code: A Quantitative Study Using a Custom Scoring Framework
researchHighlights.coreContribution: Designing and validating a hybrid vulnerability scoring framework that combines OWASP Top 10, CVSS v3.1, and an AI-specific vulnerability pattern layer to systematically evaluate security risks in LLM-generated code
researchHighlights.practitionerAngle: The research is directly informed by Craig's production experience building and evaluating LLM systems. His dissertation investigates failure modes he has observed in real deployments, not just synthetic benchmarks.
researchHighlights.significance: Fills a validated gap in the literature -- no reproducible framework existed for systematically evaluating AI-generated code security before deployment
